parrafo.es: Mario y su equipo atienden pintura, plomería, electricidad y actualizaciones de baño en Doral desde hace más de un año. Profesionales, pacientes y puntuales, tal como lo cuentan sus propios clientes.

parrafo_1.es: Mava Services Corp es una empresa de reparaciones generales con sede en Doral. Mario y su equipo hacen pintura interior y exterior, plomería, electricidad, actualizaciones de baño y limpieza a presión de entradas y patios.
parrafo_1.en: Mava Services Corp is a general handyman company based in Doral. Mario and his crew handle interior and exterior painting, plumbing, electrical fixes, bathroom updates and pressure washing for driveways and patios.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: profesional, tranquilo y encuentra la forma de cumplir los plazos sin bajar la calidad. Roberto Alvarez lleva más de un año confiándole trabajos de plomería, electricidad y pintura en su casa.
parrafo_2.en: Review after review says the same thing: professional, calm under pressure, and he finds a way to meet deadlines without cutting corners. Roberto Alvarez has trusted him with plumbing, electrical and painting jobs at his home for over a year.

items.quote: I consider Mario a friend and a great professional. He can handle many types of jobs and always keeps his cool, has patience and finds a way to meet deadlines while delivering the highest quality work.

Mario has done several plumbing, electric, and painting jobs at our home for over a year at reasonable prices. His work is excellent. He has always shown responsiveness for which I highly recommend him for any handyman services.
Excellent work, the guys from Mava Services, the change they made in my bathroom was great.
